retirement.title: Retirement Planner
retirement.description: Plan your retirement with a comprehensive savings and withdrawal projection
retirement.subtitle: Secure your financial future
retirement.desiredIncomeHelp: How much you want to spend monthly in retirement, in today's dollars
retirement.preRetirementReturnHelp: Expected annual return while saving (stocks avg ~7-10%)
retirement.heroSufficient: Your savings will last {years} years in retirement
retirement.heroInsufficient: Your savings may run out at age {age}
retirement.formulaText: Accumulation: FV = PV(1+r)^n + PMT[((1+r)^n-1)/r] | Withdrawal: Balance_n = Balance_(n-1)(1+r) - W
retirement.formulaExplanation: Two-phase simulation: grow savings until retirement, then draw down with inflation-adjusted withdrawals

fire.title: FIRE Calculator
fire.description: Calculate your Financial Independence, Retire Early number
fire.subtitle: Find your path to financial independence
fire.heroOnTrack: You can reach FIRE at age {age}
fire.fireNumberHelp: Annual expenses divided by safe withdrawal rate
fire.leanFIREHelp: Covers basic expenses only (50% of current)
fire.coastFIREHelp: Stop saving — investments grow to target by retirement
fire.formulaText: FIRE Number = Annual Expenses / SWR; Years = ln(FN/S × r + 1) / ln(1 + r)
fire.formulaExplanation: Calculates when investments can sustain your lifestyle through safe withdrawals

monteCarlo.title: Monte Carlo Simulator
monteCarlo.description: Stress-test your financial plan with probabilistic modeling
monteCarlo.subtitle: Run thousands of market simulations to see how your plan holds up
monteCarlo.volatilityHelp: S&P 500 historical: ~15%. Higher = wider outcome range.
monteCarlo.simulationsHelp: More simulations = more accurate percentiles, but slower
monteCarlo.successRateDescription: {total} simulations run, {failures} ran out of money
monteCarlo.formulaText: Monthly return = Normal(μ/12, σ/√12); Balance_t = Balance_(t-1) × (1 + r_t) + C - W
monteCarlo.formulaExplanation: Each month draws a random return from a normal distribution. Contributions are added, inflation-adjusted withdrawals subtracted. Repeated across N simulations.

taxEstimator.description: Estimate your US federal income tax and effective rate

taxEstimator.formulaText: Tax = Σ (bracket_amount × bracket_rate) for each bracket
taxEstimator.formulaExplanation: Progressive taxation: income is taxed at increasing rates as it moves through tax brackets
taxEstimator.assumptionScope: Federal income tax only (excludes state, FICA)
